Specify ordered innovation residualization

Source: R/hierarchy_recipe.R
ordered_innovation.Rd

Fits a mapping from earlier-stage scores to the current stage on training observations and stores the coefficient matrix so new rows can be residualized independently.

Usage

ordered_innovation(method = c("svd", "ridge"), tolerance = 1e-07, lambda = 0)

Arguments

method

"svd" uses a rank-aware least-squares mapping; "ridge" uses \(\|Z - HB\|_F^2 + \lambda\|B\|_F^2\).

tolerance

SVD rank tolerance factor, used as s_i > tolerance * max(dim(H)) * s[1].

lambda

Ridge penalty. A non-negative number, or the string "blocked_cv" (not yet implemented). Ignored when method = "svd" except that "blocked_cv" is still rejected.

Value

An object of class ordered_innovation.
